fullPassage: Research findings can inject life into an idea in a way that helps us to appreciate its significance and plausibility. In this sense, research in the social sciences can function like photographs in journalism. They move us to consider a point of view. My introduction to Skinnerian reinforcement theory was just of this sort. Although prepared to resist the theory on intellectual and political grounds, as I watched the professor use food pellets to bring the random movements of a pigeon under his control, I couldn't escape the power of the behaviourist perspective. Its plausibility will always remain with me. By the same token, Piaget's famous experiments with children's problem-solving do not furnish us with the truth about human development. However, they draw our attention to significant alternatives to behaviourism in understanding children's learning.

det.tip: 비유: 연구 findings = 저널리즘의 photographs. 추상을 구체화.

questions.passage: Research findings can inject life into an idea in a way that helps us to appreciate its significance and plausibility. In this sense, research in the social sciences can function like photographs in journalism. They move us to consider a point of view. My introduction to Skinnerian reinforcement theory was just of this sort. Although prepared to resist the theory on intellectual and political grounds, as I watched the professor use food pellets to bring the random movements of a pigeon under his control, I couldn't escape the power of the behaviourist perspective. Its plausibility will always remain with me. ____, Piaget's famous experiments with children's problem-solving do not furnish us with the truth about human development. However, they draw our attention to significant alternatives to behaviourism in understanding children's learning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② By the same token: '같은 이유로, 마찬가지로'. Skinner 사례 후 Piaget 사례로 연결.
❌ ① On the contrary: '반대로'는 같은 원리 반복과 반대.
❌ ③ In contrast: '대조적으로'도 반대 방향.
❌ ④ Despite this: '이에도 불구하고'는 문맥상 부적절.
det.tip: By the same token = 같은 원리로/마찬가지로. 두 사례를 병렬로 연결.
